intro.title: Why groundwater?
intro.lede: Rain moves through soil and rock into an aquifer. Wells reveal only a small window into a connected underground system.

items.title: The aquifer is shared
items.text: Water pumped from one well can affect neighbours drawing from the same underground store.

items.title: Rainfall is not recharge
items.text: Only part of rain reaches groundwater; soils, geology, land use and structures shape the journey.

items.title: Trends need time
items.text: A single reading is a snapshot. Repeated measurements reveal depletion, recovery and seasonal rhythm.

items.title: The MARVI 4-S Strategy
items.text: Sense, Store, Share, Sustain: how a village manages the aquifer it shares.
